names.note: The calendar’s own name page for her is «Александра (Устюхина), мц.»; the rank is stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «мцц. Александры». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Анатолия, Александра, Евгения, Константина, Николая пресвитеров, и с ними мчч. Петра, Евсевия, Михаила, Дорофея, Лаврентия, Григория и мцц. Александры и Татианы (1937).»

attestations.note: Twelfth of the thirteen one line enumerates, and the first of the two women it sets apart as «мцц.», мученицы. THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS for her, and the name page adds no monastic grade. `related` is left empty for the whole company, as the corpus leaves it for the thirty-four of Valaam; the line is quoted whole here instead. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century entries. No folder held her: a Cyrillic grep for «Устюхина» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page prints eleven hymns and none is under any of the thirteen names.
